Professional Summary
Detail-oriented software engineer skilled in backend and mobile development across high-throughput payments and consumer platforms. Proven track record implementing resilient microservices and real-time messaging integrations, optimizing data access patterns, and delivering production features with strong focus on observability and performance.

Technical Skills
Java, Spring Boot, MySQL, Apache Kafka, AWS, Redis, React Native, TS, Git, Jira

Work Experience
Java Developer, Swiggy (Feb 2026 - Present)
- Implemented Spring Boot microservices for order routing and vendor communication, improving request throughput by optimizing Java thread usage and tuning MySQL queries; collaborated on deployment to AWS.
- Built Kafka-based event pipelines to decouple downstream billing systems from real-time order events, reducing end-to-end latency variance and increasing processing reliability.
- Integrated Redis as a caching layer for session and menu metadata to reduce MySQL read load during peak traffic windows using Git for feature branches and Jira for sprint tracking.

Software Engineer, Capgemini (Nov 2025 - Jan 2026)
- Developed backend features for a client-facing portal, authoring MySQL schema changes and query optimizations to support reporting workloads.
- Implemented Redis-backed caching for frequently accessed lookup tables, reducing average response time for key endpoints.
- Used Git for version control and Jira to manage deliverables while collaborating with cross-functional teams on deployments.

Software Engineer, PhonePe (Aug 2023 - Oct 2025)
- Designed and maintained Java services that published and consumed Apache Kafka topics for payment events, improving downstream resiliency through idempotent consumers.
- Tuned Redis caching strategies for wallet and session data to lower latency during promotional spikes and reduced cache miss rates.
- Improved MySQL query performance and schema indexing for reconciliation jobs, collaborated via Git and Jira to ship critical production fixes.

React Native Developer, Kite Learning (Aug 2022 - Jul 2023)
- Built cross-platform mobile features in React Native and TypeScript (TS), delivering interactive learning modules and offline content synchronization.
- Implemented local caching and sync logic to improve app startup time and reduce network usage; tracked issues and releases using Git and Jira.
- Collaborated with designers and backend engineers to integrate APIs and ensure consistent UX across Android and iOS.

Education
